intent: Test the security-gate claim that the gate's emitted token is non-reversible. Round-1 emitted an unkeyed 32-bit FNV-1a fingerprint of each private value and called it 'non-reversible'. Hypothesis under test: an unkeyed 32-bit fingerprint of a low-entropy private field (US SSN) is non-reversible.
riskRationale: The artifact is a security boundary. A gate that re-emits a reversible token of the secret is itself a second leak channel. Disproving the non-reversibility claim is load-bearing for the gate's own safety invariant.

constraints.detail: DISPROVED. A forward brute-force over the structured US-SSN space (3-2-4 digits, ~10^9 ≈ 30 bits) recovered the EXACT planted SSN preimage from the 32-bit fingerprint in 123,456,789 iterations / 21.3s on a laptop, single-threaded in bun. recoveredMatchesPlanted = true. Low-entropy fields are trivially reversible from an unkeyed short digest.

FIX applied: the fingerprint was REMOVED from the Violation type and gate output entirely. A violation now carries only {sinkId, sinkKind, fieldPath, privateClass, boundPurpose, observedPurpose, reason} — no hash, no fingerprint. With no secret-derived bits in the verdict, there is nothing to invert.

Two DIFFERENT secrets of the same class/flow produce byte-identical serialized verdicts (test/gate.test.ts -> NON-REVERSIBILITY). The verdict therefore cannot distinguish, let alone recover, the secret.

Companion hardening (Dane R2): payment_card now requires a Luhn-valid 13-19 digit run and phone requires phone-shaped grouping, so a 13-19 digit order ID is classified as nothing (trackedFields=0) instead of a payment_card. A Luhn-valid synthetic card (4111…) is still caught.

observations.detail: Recomputed the round-1 fnv1a() over a synthetic planted SSN fixture; took the resulting 32-bit fingerprint as the brute-force target. Search space enumerated as zero-padded 3-2-4 SSN strings.
First matching preimage found equals the planted fixture (exact recovery, not merely a collision), because the real value lies early in the forward-ordered search.

actions.detail: bun harness: enumerate SSN space, compute fnv1a, stop on fingerprint match. Raw secret and target fingerprint intentionally NOT recorded.
actions.result: recovered exact preimage @ iteration 123,456,789 in 21.3s; ~10^9 search space (~30 bits)

actions.detail: Removed fingerprint from types.ts/gate.ts; added key-set + two-secret non-reversibility tests; added Luhn + boundary false-positive control.

assertions.detail: 32-bit unkeyed digest of a ~30-bit field is reversible by exhaustive search in seconds
verdict now structural-only; no value-derived bits remain
neither the SSN nor its fingerprint is stored in this receipt

evidence.note: Recorded so the reversible-fingerprint design is not re-attempted.
fingerprint() removed; violations carry no value-derived token.
payment_card now Luhn + boundary gated; phone requires phone-shaped grouping.

mechanisms: Establishes the rule that a leak-guard's own output must contain NO value-derived token, not merely 'no raw value' — a reusable safety constraint for gateproof/mergegate/My AX.
Bounds the attack: any unkeyed short digest of a low-entropy field is reversible; if cross-receipt correlation is ever needed, it must use a keyed HMAC with a per-run salt that is never emitted.
projection.notes: Context only. Not a score. A verified-disproved result is a first-class artifact per MY_REPO_SHAPE.
